ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTDEPOSITSOUTSTANDINGBALANCE] @Businessdate [VARCHAR](10) AS
BEGIN

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND @Businessdate BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,
CNT_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
AS
(
      SELECT ca.Customeraccountid, COUNT(ca.recordtypeid) AS CNT FROM (
select Customeraccountid,recordtypeid, MAX([TIMESTAMP]) AS max_timwstamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
 GROUP BY Customeraccountid,recordtypeid) ca
 GROUP BY Customeraccountid
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,BalanceAmountFull
    ,BalanceAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
@Businessdate AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END  AS BalanceAmountFull
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
    END AS BalanceAmountProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCPB.PeriodStartDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BAAS ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BAAS.CustomerAccountId AND BAAS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankId
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDHT ON BAAS.RecordTypeId = DDHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND BAAS.SourceSystemCode = DDHT.SourceSystemCode AND DDHT.BankSK = DDBK.BankSK
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId 

--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BAAS ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BAAS.CustomerAccountId 
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDHT ON BAAS.RecordTypeId = DDHT.AccountHolderTypeID
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = convert(varchar,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId)
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON convert(varchar,BCAFP.FinancialProductId) = DDP.ProductId
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProduct BFP ON convert(varchar,BCAFP.FinancialProductId) = BFP.FinancialProductId
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimProductType DDPT ON BFP.ProductTypeId = DDPT.ProductTypeId 
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
and @Businessdate NOT IN (SELECT BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance)

END
GO
